name: CLI Full-Text Search
statement: A developer searches across all stored knowledge using full-text queries from the terminal, receiving ranked results with relevance scores.
successCriteria: limen search --query 'lazy fox' returns JSON array of SearchResult objects
Each result contains belief (BeliefView), relevance (BM25 score), and score (combined) fields
limen search --query 'test' --limit 5 returns at most 5 results
limen search --query 'test' --minConfidence 0.8 filters by confidence threshold
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen search without --query produces non-JSON error or crashes
limen search --query '' (empty) crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen search --limit 'abc' crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen search --minConfidence 2 crashes instead of returning JSON error
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
At least one claim stored for search to find
